provedBoundary: The original post-read poll assertion at Scenario64 fails under the same15s post-ACK observer. Last readiness is101reads/15054.1708ms, allocated/owned/attached/nativeReady:false, no diagnostic. This last snapshot does not identify the particular catalog/provider callback still pending.

The retained native resume/unknown record, interpreted through HostWindowsLaunch.request, means the closed HostCustodyClient request resolved status unknown. It is not a thrown currentness failure, launch-deadline reason, explicit refused reply, or result-mismatch record.

Unknown alone does not identify an original Main wire reply: the Host client can settle unknown from its pending-request timer, a synchronous send exception, an accepted unknown response, or sealing a dispatched pending request. Pre-admission expiry and malformed/lazy-builder refusal instead return refused.

The original Main wrapper actually entered resume once and its awaited physical handler threw: calls1,settled1,returned0. The original diagnostic still does not reveal the thrown exception, OS acknowledgement, or the exact Host unknown-producing branch.

sameClockOrder.basis: Every value below is an original performance.now sample minus the same Main epoch phaseClock in Scenario179/198–211/291. These are not mixed Date and performance clocks.
sameClockOrder.implication: Main resume remained in flight when original failure cleanup began, and original Stop completed before that await threw. This failed settlement cannot alone be treated as the cause of the preceding readiness cutoff. The first-refusal row lacks its own timestamp, so its Host-local publication may not be placed before or after the cutoff from this evidence.

armAssessmentVerified.sourceAlternativesUnselected: Physical resume includes fresh verifyLaunch and native resume request, with owner/input guards before and after awaits. Close/seal can refuse in-flight work; independent timer/transport/response failures are also possible. None is established as the historical underlying operand, and no fresh-file check, currentness guard or deadline may be removed on this basis.
